notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Howlsquad Heavy.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
